en.title: One identifies you, the other admits you
en.focal: A valid passport is not permission to enter
en.alt: Comparison diagram of a passport and a visa: your own country issues the passport, it proves who you are and lets you leave home, while the destination issues the visa, which grants permission to enter and covers only that one country, with a note that most trips need both
en.caption: Two documents, two jobs - and a valid passport on its own is not permission to enter.
